headline: China will take "necessary measures" after new US restrictions on chip exports
summary: China said it will take necessary measures to defend its interests after new US restrictions on chip exports, announced following suspicions of Nvidia products being diverted to Chinese firms.
why: Nvidia designs the AI accelerator chips that power much of global data-center spending, so US export controls on them directly affect its China revenue and the broader semiconductor supply chain.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: New US export curbs on chips may limit Nvidia's ability to sell certain products to Chinese customers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: New US export restrictions on chips and China's pledge of countermeasures raise uncertainty over sales to Chinese customers. The restrictions follow suspicions that Nvidia products were diverted to Chinese companies.
original_headline: China tomará "medidas necesarias" tras nuevas restricciones de EU a exportaciones de chips
